newsitem.title: USA: Duff rates Empresa Nacional de Electricidad bonds.
newsitem.headline: Duff rates Empresa Nacional de Electricidad bonds.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Tuesday it assigned a Single A Minus rating to Empresa Nacional de Electricidad SA's (Chile) proposed US$580 million issuance of senior unsecured Yankee bonds.

The issuance will have three tranches with varying maturities and proceeds of the debt offering will be used to partially fund construction of several projects in Chile, refinance existing indebtedness and make a loan to affiliate El Chorcon to refinance existing debt.
The utility's ratings are based on its efficient, low-cost hydroelectric generation operations, its leading market position and solid financial profile, Duff & Phelps said.
